outputs.bab-01-moon-star: Night of the 11th, beginning of the night, the Moon was 1 cubit 8 fingers in front of delta Capricorni
outputs.bab-02-moon-planet: Night of the 2nd, Jupiter was behind the Moon; it was 1 1/2 cubits behind, the Moon being 1 cubit high to the north
outputs.bab-03-planet-planet: Night of the 24th, first part of the night, Venus was 3 fingers below Mars; Venus was 2 fingers back to the west
outputs.bab-04-heliacal-rising: Month VIII, the 13th, sunrise to rising of Venus: 12°; I did not watch
outputs.bab-05-lunar-first-visibility: Night of the 1st, sunrise to moonset: 2°; the 1st followed the 30th of the preceding month, I did not watch
